message.content:
This editorial illustration is the front cover of Tempo magazine, edition "30 JULI-5 AGUSTUS 2012." The background features a body of water with distant tan-colored landmasses under a light sky. A large red title "TEMPO" sits above the headline "SENGKARUT JEMBATAN SELAT SUNDA." Smaller text at the top reads: "MEMBUKA KASUS 'PETRUS'," "NASIB KASUS VIDEO ARIEL," and "REZEKI PILKADA LEMBAGA SURVEI."

In the center, a large suspension bridge is shown in two disconnected sections. The right section features a tall, light-tan pylon structure with suspension cables supporting a grey roadway with parallel lines. This section ends abruptly in mid-air. The left section is a lower, shorter segment of the bridge. Both road surfaces are grey with brown railroad-style tracks. Two small illustrated men stand on the broken edges of the bridge sections, facing each other across the gap. The man on the left wears a white shirt, blue pants, and a red cap, while the man on the right wears a white shirt, brown pants, and a red cap. A small portion of a red and black ship hull is visible on the far right. A barcode and price "RP 29.700" are in the bottom left corner.
